zh-CN.title: 探索者外观 · 小哀表情
items: 普通消息保留 3em 小哀表情并向左延伸至内边距，保持在边框以内
引用消息恢复 1em 表情和紧凑间距，与引用内容对齐

en.title: Explorer styles · Ai expressions
items: Regular messages keep 3em Ai expressions extending into the left padding, within the bubble border
Replies use 1em expressions with compact spacing, aligned with the quoted content
